title: Multi-Agent Quality Gate (Hermes validator for evolution)
summary: Karpathy's multi-agent swarm pattern uses a 'Hermes Quality Gate': after each generation, an independent validator (Claude Opus) scores fitness for generalization, flags overfitting, prevents hallucinations from compounding. Apply: post each 6-island generation, run Claude Opus audit on top 3 features (check for temporal leakage, data leakage, overfitting). Mark features as 'validated' or 'flagged', only validated features move forward.
implementation_steps: Create validate_generation.py: takes generation JSON, top 3 features, calls Claude Opus with prompt
Prompt: 'These are new NBA features. Score each 0-10 for data leakage risk, temporal leakage, overfitting risk, explain'
Claude returns scores + reasoning
Features with score < 7: move to 'experimental' bin, re-test next gen before live deployment
Log to validation-log.jsonl: {gen, feature, opus_score, opus_reason, decision}
code_template: Integrate Claude Code + Sonnet 4.5 async calls (see CLAUDE.md MCP Supabase for credentials)

title: Agentic Engineering: Replace manual feature engineering with agent-driven specs

Enables 2-3x faster experimentation. Expected: fewer subtle bugs (agent code often cleaner), faster validation loops.

Template: goal, calculation, expected Brier delta, edge cases, data sources
Submit to Claude Code with: 'Implement this feature in features/engine.py'
Claude generates code + tests + deployment instructions
You review, approve, merge. Time saved: 30 min/feature vs 60 min manual

title: Multi-Agent Hypothesis → Executor → Evaluator Split (Evolution Scaling)
summary: Karpathy's emerging pattern: split single agent into 3 specialized roles. (1) Hypothesis Agent: proposes experiments based on past Brier improvements, domain knowledge. (2) Executor: runs experiments on 6 islands in parallel, collects metrics. (3) Evaluator: decides what to keep, updates shared knowledge. Benefits: hypothesis generator can explore wider search space while executor keeps GPU busy, evaluator filters hallucinations. Effort: refactor autonomous-cycle.sh into 3-agent DAG.
implementation_steps: Create 3 new scripts: hypothesis_agent.py, executor_agent.py, evaluator_agent.py
hypothesis_agent.py: reads past 50 generations, finds patterns ('features with Cat=39 improved Brier'), proposes next 5 mutations
executor_agent.py: deploys each mutation to 6 islands (parallel), collects results, logs to execution_log.jsonl
evaluator_agent.py: reads execution_log, scores each result (Brier, ROI, Sharpe, consistency), decides which to commit
Orchestrate with Celery or simple bash DAG in autonomous-cycle.sh
blocker: Requires parallel GPU management (May not fit P100 constraint)
